system.description: The Warlord must have his enemy--they cannot exist without one another. This Charm permits the raksha to define both himself and a particular antagonist (who must exist and must currently hold an antagonistic posture toward him) as the principal characters in the raksha's narrative. While the Charm continues to function, it automatically negates all shaping effects that would otherwise remove either the raksha or his named antagonist as active characters in the story. No one can shape the raksha into quiescence, banishment or death without also in some manner restoring him to life and/ or activity.
